_about: The relit mode's per-level choices ([Graphics] rt_relit, engine/gfx/rt_relit.h), built into the exe; thug2-decomp-relit.json beside the exe (the same layout) adds to them and wins. Each level by its scene's name: "relit": false keeps the level's bake, "sun": "level" keeps its baked sun under rt_sun_source=game (every effect's sun - engine/gfx/rt_scene.h scene_sun - where the game's sun looks wrong there), "north": the world heading (degrees, round from +z toward +x) of its north - the time of day's sun path turned so (engine/gfx/rt_daylight.h NativeInputs; without it north is where the bake's sun puts it). A level whose bake shows no sun (night, indoors) is relit by its sky, bounce and lamps.
